Preserve full legacy Arena until Godot parity and physical device proof. New staging runtime 2.0.3 only when all opt-ins present.

productionBaselineEvidence: Production BUKLOD MAIN package org.mzbministry.buklod, runtime 1.3.2 and EAS production channel in existing app.config.js/eas.json remain unchanged. Existing signed Genesis staging source and live server use separate authority; no current production OTA or Play artifact is modified by this isolated branch.
selectionRationale: Reuses precompiled and inspected Godot 4.7.2 Android AAR with one signed APK game archive, rather than re-exporting Godot into a separate app or converting every new animation to React Native; this preserves existing MAIN routes and the secure server-owned economy while enabling native gameplay.
alternativeApproaches: Build a second standalone Godot APK (rejected: violates user requirement of one BUKLOD MAIN Android app and forks auth/navigation/data).
Convert all gameplay to React Native JavaScript (rejected: duplicates engine physics/rendering and loses native GDScript gameplay benefits).
Add unrelated game SDKs before determining missing capabilities (rejected: existing Godot and Stream/Expo native stack already covers required baseline).
